**Motif:** fork (the queen gives check while attacking the rook, winning it)

**Coaching note (80 words):**

Your queen on b3 was attacking two undefended White pieces: the rook on d1 and the pawn on b2. When White left the rook undefended after playing f6, you had a tactical blow. Qxd1+ is a royal fork—it gives check while capturing the rook, so White must move the king and you've won a whole piece. After Kf2 Qxf3+, you keep checking and attacking, maintaining your material advantage. Always scan your queen's attacking lines for undefended pieces, especially when your opponent moves carelessly.
